traceability.evidence:
Implementation: - Core maintenance module: - src/maintenance/index.ts - Exports: detectStaleAnnotations, updateAnnotationReferences, batchUpdateAnnotations, verifyAnnotations, generateMaintenanceReport. - JSDoc: @story docs/stories/009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS.story.md and @req REQ-MAINT-DETECT/UPDATE/BATCH/VERIFY/REPORT/SAFE. - src/maintenance/detect.ts - Function: detectStaleAnnotations(codebasePath: string): string[]. - Behavior: - Resolves workspaceRoot from process.cwd() and codebasePath. - Returns [] if workspaceRoot does not exist or is not a directory. - Uses getAllFiles(workspaceRoot) to visit all files. - Regex-matches @story paths and for each match: - Skips unsafe paths via isUnsafeStoryPath (security and safety handling). - Resolves project and codebase candidates and enforces project boundaries via enforceProjectBoundary. - Only stats in-project candidates and marks storyPath as stale when no candidate exists on disk. - src/maintenance/update.ts - Function: updateAnnotationReferences(codebasePath, oldPath, newPath): number. - Behavior: - Returns 0 if codebasePath does not exist or is not a directory. - Escapes oldPath and constructs RegExp `(@story\s*)${escapedOldPath}`. - Uses getAllFiles(codebasePath) and processFileForAnnotationUpdates to: - Skip non-file entries. - Replace only matching @story annotations via a callback that increments a counter. - Write files only when content changes, preserving other code/formatting. - src/maintenance/batch.ts - batchUpdateAnnotations(codebasePath, mappings): number - Loops over mappings { oldPath, newPath } and sums updateAnnotationReferences results (REQ-MAINT-BATCH). - verifyAnnotations(codebasePath): boolean - Calls detectStaleAnnotations and returns stale.length === 0 (REQ-MAINT-VERIFY). - src/maintenance/report.ts - generateMaintenanceReport(codebasePath): string. - Behavior: - Calls detectStaleAnnotations. - Returns "" when no stale annotations (safe no-op). - Returns newline-separated list of stale story paths otherwise (REQ-MAINT-REPORT, REQ-MAINT-SAFE). - src/maintenance/utils.ts - getAllFiles(dir: string): string[]. - Behavior: - Returns [] if dir does not exist or is not a directory. - Recursively traverses and collects only regular file paths (used by detect & update). - src/maintenance/cli.ts - runMaintenanceCli(rawArgv: string[]): number. - Commands: detect, verify, report, update. - Flag parsing: --root, --json, --format, --from, --to, --dry-run. - handleDetect: - Uses detectStaleAnnotations(flags.root). - Text mode: prints "No stale @story annotations found." on clean; otherwise prints each stale path plus a summary and guidance. - JSON mode (--json): prints JSON { root, stale }. - Exit codes: 0 when no stale, 1 when stale (REQ-MAINT-DETECT, REQ-MAINT-REPORT, REQ-MAINT-SAFE). - handleVerify: - Uses verifyAnnotations(root). - On success: logs success message and returns 0. - On failure: logs guidance to use detect/report and returns 1 (REQ-MAINT-VERIFY, REQ-MAINT-SAFE). - handleReport: - Uses generateMaintenanceReport(root). - Supports --format text|json. - Text: prints friendly header and stale story list or a "Nothing to report" message. - JSON: prints { root, report }. - handleUpdate: - Requires --from and --to; otherwise logs error, prints help, and returns exit code 2 (usage error) (REQ-MAINT-SAFE). - --dry-run: does not modify files; derives an estimatedStaleCount from generateMaintenanceReport and prints clear text or JSON summary (reversibility and safety). - Real update: calls updateAnnotationReferences(root, from, to) and logs `Updated N @story annotations ...` (REQ-MAINT-UPDATE). - Global error handler: catches unexpected errors, logs `traceability-maint failed: `, returns exit code 2 (REQ-MAINT-SAFE). - printHelp(): prints full command/option usage (user experience). - CLI integration: - package.json: - "bin": { "traceability-maint": "lib/src/maintenance/cli.js" }, wiring the CLI name to the built CLI entry point.

tests/maintenance/detect.test.ts - Confirms detectStaleAnnotations(tmpDir) returns [] when no @story annotations exist. - Creates a file with `@story stale.story.md` and asserts result contains that story once (REQ-MAINT-DETECT). - tests/maintenance/detect-isolated.test.ts - `returns empty array when directory does not exist` => detectStaleAnnotations("non-existent-dir") === []. - `detects stale annotations in nested directories` => multiple stale story paths detected across nested dirs. - `throws error on permission denied` => shows permission errors propagate (API level behavior). - Security/edge test: verifies detectStaleAnnotations does not call fs.existsSync on unsafe/invalid paths (../outside-project.story.md, /etc/passwd.story.md, invalid.txt) while still checking legitimate in-workspace .story.md paths (REQ-MAINT-DETECT, safety). - tests/maintenance/update.test.ts - Verifies updateAnnotationReferences returns 0 when there is nothing to replace (REQ-MAINT-UPDATE). - tests/maintenance/update-isolated.test.ts - Writes file with `@story old.path.md`, runs updateAnnotationReferences(tmpDir, "old.path.md", "new.path.md"). - Asserts count === 1 and updated content contains `@story new.path.md`. - Verifies calling on non-existent directory returns 0 (REQ-MAINT-UPDATE, safety). - tests/maintenance/batch.test.ts - batchUpdateAnnotations(tmpDir, []) returns 0 (batch no-op) (REQ-MAINT-BATCH). - verifyAnnotations(tmpDir) returns true when a valid @story has a corresponding .story.md present (REQ-MAINT-VERIFY). - tests/maintenance/report.test.ts - generateMaintenanceReport(tmpDir) returns "" when no stale refs. - After writing `@story non-existent.story.md`, report contains that story path (REQ-MAINT-REPORT, REQ-MAINT-SAFE). - tests/maintenance/cli.test.ts - detect: on empty workspace, exit code 0 and logs "No stale @story annotations found." (REQ-MAINT-DETECT, UX). - verify: with valid annotation + story file, exit 0 and single log call (REQ-MAINT-VERIFY). - report: with missing story, exit 0 and logs that include "Traceability Maintenance Report" and the missing filename (REQ-MAINT-REPORT). - update: with `@story old.path.md` and appropriate flags, exit 0 and file updated to `@story new.path.md` (REQ-MAINT-UPDATE). - update missing flags: exit 2, console.error and console.log invoked (REQ-MAINT-SAFE). - update --dry-run: exit 0, file unchanged, logs dry-run summary (REQ-MAINT-SAFE, reversibility). - detect --json: with a stale story, exit 1 and JSON output whose .stale array includes the stale path (REQ-MAINT-DETECT, REQ-MAINT-REPORT, UX/tooling).

traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for 009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS are satisfied: - Core Functionality: Implemented detection (detectStaleAnnotations), targeted updates (updateAnnotationReferences), batch updates (batchUpdateAnnotations), verification (verifyAnnotations), and reporting (generateMaintenanceReport), with a dedicated maintenance CLI (traceability-maint) exposing detect/verify/report/update. - Quality Standards: Update logic only changes @story values, writes files only on content change, and utility traversal preserves existing file content/formatting beyond the updated annotation segment; tests confirm correct before/after behavior. - Integration: Maintenance tools are part of the plugin source tree, exported via src/maintenance/index.ts, wired in package.json as a CLI, and documented in user-facing docs (README.md, user-docs/api-reference.md). - User Experience: CLI commands have clear help text, human-readable and JSON outputs, explicit success/failure messages, and distinct exit codes (0, 1, 2), with tests asserting these messages and codes. - Error Handling: Code handles non-existent directories by returning safe defaults, propagates low-level errors at the API layer and wraps them at the CLI layer with concise diagnostics, and explicitly avoids touching unsafe or out-of-project story paths; tests cover non-existent directories, permission issues, and security validation paths. - Documentation: Maintenance tools and CLI are documented in README.md and user-docs/api-reference.md with examples and behavioral descriptions. Comprehensive tests under tests/maintenance/* reference this story and its REQ-MAINT-* requirements, and `npm test` runs successfully. Therefore, the story is assessed as fully implemented (PASSED).
